pull.title: MINOR: Fix consumer group offset handler chain indentation
pull.body:
Two method-chain continuation lines in `ListConsumerGroupOffsetsHandler.coordinatorKeys()` use 11 leading spaces. Align them at 12 spaces, consistent with Kafka's default `Indentation` configuration.

These existing formatting errors are detected by the wrapped-return-expression fix in checkstyle/checkstyle#21833 and cause its Kafka compatibility job to fail. This change only adds one space to each line.

Validation: ran Kafka's full Checkstyle configuration against this file using the Checkstyle build from that PR. The original file reports the two violations at lines 85 and 86; the corrected file passes with zero violations. No behavior changes or new tests.

Prepared with assistance from OpenAI Codex. This contribution is original work and is licensed under the project's Apache License 2.0.

issue.title: Issue #18197: Fix indentation of wrapped return expressions

license.name: GNU Lesser General Public License v2.1

issue.body:
Issue #18197

`Indentation` misses line-wrapping violations in returned arithmetic expressions and method chains. In the reported example, only one of five incorrectly indented continuation lines is reported, using a misleading `method def` message.

Check the return keyword with the enclosing statement handler and route the returned expression through line-wrapping validation. Continuation errors now name the offending operator and respect `forceStrictCondition`. Keep nested arguments and bodies with their existing handlers, and avoid cascading continuation diagnostics from an incorrectly indented return keyword.

Regression inputs cover the reported arithmetic and method-chain cases in strict and non-strict modes, with valid arguments, parenthesized and ternary expressions, constructor/lambda/switch bodies, inline returns after an if, statement-line indentation after braces/comments/case labels, an expression beginning after the return line, and bare returns. Existing diagnostic expectations are updated to identify the expression token.

Correct existing return-chain indentation in `CheckstyleAntTask`, `TestUtil`, and two OpenJDK naming inputs that is newly detected by the fix.

Validation:

- Full unit and integration suites passed: 6,930 unit tests (two existing skips), 1,383 integration tests, and coverage requirements. Remaining verification passed separately after removing a local coverage artifact.
- All 280 tests in the indentation package passed.
- Focused mutation testing of the four changed methods in `AbstractExpressionHandler` and `LineWrappingHandler` passed with the native `pitest-indentation` mutators and thresholds: 30/30 mutations killed, with 100% line coverage of the two targeted classes. Unmodified methods were excluded from mutation generation.
- Repository Checkstyle, PMD, SpotBugs, forbidden API checks, and XML/JSON validation passed.
- Sevntu checks passed.
- The review update introduces no new unknown spelling words compared with the previous PR head.



Diff Regression config: https://gist.githubusercontent.com/ishu7w/f6c925d362c90d101e53e603ad0f2d28/raw/5ab1d696443acdd1582bef02fcee5aa07ec6fe90/return-wrapping-example3.xml
Report label: Indentation Example3 strict
